column1: # The case map: one row per renamed TEST_CASE or SUBCASE -- its file, its old name, its new name,
# tab-separated, each name as the source spells it with its literals joined. It is the one owner
# of a rename: cases.py applies it, prove.py puts each old name back before it compares, and a
# rename it does not hold is a difference. A row struck with a leading `#` is not applied. It
# holds the rows of one pull request; earlier rows are in Git and in their report.
